# W101: an internal element is not deployed in any region

**Severity:** warning · **Stage:** validator

Every service, store, and queue needs somewhere to run.

## Failing example

```saxl
system Shop
actor Buyer
service Web
Buyer -> Web
```

## Fixed example

```saxl
system Shop
actor Buyer
service Web
Buyer -> Web
deploy region eu {
  cluster main {
    Web x2
  }
}
```
